title: 2BR TOWNHOMES in Columbus
description:
Welcome Home to 540 S Wayne Avenue
There's something nice about having a place that simply feels like home; comfortable, welcoming, and with a little more space and privacy than your typical apartment. A charming 2-bedroom home on Columbus' west side that blends the character of an older neighborhood home with thoughtful updates throughout.
Step inside and you'll find a bright, comfortable living room with updated flooring, soft neutral colors, and plenty of natural light. Just beyond, the kitchen has been nicely refreshed with crisp white cabinetry, subway tile backsplash, updated countertops, black appliances, and additional cabinetry and counter space that make the room surprisingly functional for everyday cooking and storage.
Upstairs, two carpeted bedrooms offer comfortable private spaces, including ceiling fans and plenty of natural light. The full bathroom has also been updated with a modern vanity, matte-black fixtures, contemporary lighting, and a wonderfully fun patterned tile surround that gives the space a little personality of its own.
But some of the best features of this home are the practical ones you don't always find in a rental. Washer & Dryer hookups, along with covered off-street parking beneath a large carport and a private & lockable outdoor storage shed ~ perfect for bikes, tools, seasonal items, or simply keeping the clutter out of the house. There's also a fenced outdoor area, giving you a little bit of green space right outside your doors.
The location puts you just off Sullivant Avenue with convenient access to everyday shopping and services, while Downtown Columbus and its restaurants, entertainment, and riverfront are an easy trip east. When you want to get out and enjoy the city, the downtown riverfront and Scioto Mile Promenade offer miles of space for walking, running, and enjoying the Columbus skyline.
540 S Wayne isn't trying to be a cookie-cutter home; it's a comfortable little place to call your own. With two bedrooms, an updated kitchen and bath, your own laundry, covered parking, outdoor storage, and decent yard space, there's a lot here to make everyday living just a little easier.
Welcome home!! :)

1-yr lease, 1st month's rent & security deposit due with signed lease. Tenants pay all utilities.
